nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Defines the Vite application shell, metadata and icons, applies the stored light/dark theme before first paint, and mounts the React entry point at the root element.
nodes.languageNotes: An inline defensive theme bootstrap runs before the module entry script to avoid a flash of the wrong color scheme.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Declares HETU's Node 22+ ESM package, development and native-build workflows, quality checks, PYQ data tooling, and the React, Capacitor, local-first storage, testing, and PWA dependency set.
